Scenario fixture: a11ycore-area-alt-present (“<area> must have an alt attribute”)

This file intentionally includes many edge cases to test eligibility, focusability policy (used image maps), and whole-rule outcomes. Each test area has a stable id of the form area_case_XX.

A. Used map (focusable => applicable if eligible)

01 — FAIL: used map <area> missing alt
Missing alt.
02 — PASS: used map <area> with non-empty alt
Has alt.
03 — PASS (for this atomic rule): used map <area> with empty alt=""
Empty alt allowed here.

B. aria-hidden (eligible if focusable exception applies)

04 — FAIL: used map <area aria-hidden="true"> missing alt
aria-hidden but focusable (used map) => eligible & applicable.
05 — PASS: used map <area aria-hidden="true"> with alt
aria-hidden but has alt.

C. Hidden by HTML/CSS (ineligible)

06 — Pass: hidden attribute on <area> (missing alt)
Ineligible per helper.
07 — Pass: display:none on <map> (missing alt)
Ineligible per helper.
08 — Pass: visibility:hidden on <map> (missing alt)
Ineligible per helper.

D. Inertness (special <area>/<map> behavior)

09 — FAIL: inert on <map> does not block <area> eligibility (missing alt)
Per helper exception, inert on map is ignored for <area>.
10 — FAIL: inert on <area> itself does not block eligibility (missing alt)
Per helper exception, inert on area is ignored.
11 — INELIGIBLE: inert ancestor outside <map> blocks (missing alt)
Ineligible per helper.

E. Unused maps (not focusable unless tabindex/href)

12 — INELIGIBLE: unused map <area aria-hidden="true"> missing alt
No img[usemap] references this map; aria-hidden stays ineligible.
13 — NOT APPLICABLE (per rule focusability): unused map visible area without href/tabindex
Eligible in principle, but not focusable => rule skips.
14 — FAIL: role=presentation does not change applicability (missing alt)
Role does not exclude; focusability is key.
15 — FAIL: aria-disabled does not exclude eligibility (missing alt)
aria-disabled should not exclude.
16 — FAIL: href present (still requires alt mechanism), missing alt
Href does not replace alt attribute requirement.
17 — NOT APPLICABLE: unused map with tab index
tabindex does not make it focusable => not applicable.
18 — NOT APPLICABLE: used map but referencing img is hidden
Image is ineligible => area not applicable.
19 — NOT APPLICABLE: used map but referencing img is display:none
Image is ineligible => area not applicable.
20 — NOT APPLICABLE: used map but referencing img is aria-hidden
Image is aria-hidden and not focusable => image ineligible => area not applicable.

F. ARIA naming mechanism (aria-label / aria-labelledby satisfy without alt)

21 — PASS: used map <area> with aria-label, no alt
ARIA naming (aria-label) satisfies the mechanism without alt.
22 — PASS: used map <area> with aria-labelledby referencing non-empty text, no alt
Region two label
23 — FAIL: used map <area> with aria-labelledby pointing to non-existent id, no alt
Dangling IDREF does not resolve to a name; alt is also missing.

End of fixture.
